title.narrative: Provide the assessed food insecure people in Ar-Raqqa city (Raqqa governorate) and Al Ali community (Deir-ez Zor governorate) with four monthly rounds of CVA-for-food assistance for six months

description.narrative: ltpgtIn Raqqa and Deir-ez Zor governorates, where markets are functional, Acted will provide assistance to a total of 7,080 vulnerable individuals (1,180 households) in off-camp locations in NES. ltbrgtAssistance will include the provision of four rounds of Cash-for-Food to ensure population access to basic food items, in line with SHF, Food Security Sectors, Cash Working Group’s recommendations and priorities. ltbrgtAiming to address most urgent gaps food needs, and by ensuring continuity with the targeting approach coordinated through the FSL Working Group in NES between December 2024 and January 2025, Acted plans to implement activities under the prematurely terminated USAID grant. Acted will prioritize Raqqa city, in Ar-Raqqa sub-district and district (1,932 individuals, 322 households, referred as protection cases), and in Al Ali community, in Kisreh sub-district, Deir Ez-Zor district (5,148 individuals, 858 households) using the registration previously as a basis for targeting households in the prioritized locations. ltbrgtActed’s targeting approach is based on most recent updated FSL recommendations. As part of Acted’s targeting approach, Acted previously registered and verified cases referred from Protection actors partnering with Acted, as well as from active nutrition partners, the latter through coordination with the Nutrition Working Group in NES in Ar-Raqqa specifically. ltbrgtltbrgtlt/pgt
